title: Manage
description: Add tickers, edit the weekly-email watchlist, and keep the portfolio ledger (accounts and trades). The Business Forms panels write to Postgres; the app ingests queued tickers (minutely), the weekly report reads the watchlist flag, and the Portfolio dashboard derives holdings and P/L from the ledger.

panels.title: Add ticker
panels.description: Queue a stock or crypto by its Yahoo-style symbol (e.g. NVDA, CSU.TO, XMR). Stocks are validated against SEC EDGAR and Yahoo Finance and get full price + fundamentals history; cryptocurrencies register from the <SYM>-USD Yahoo pair plus CoinGecko spot. Ingested within a minute or two — watch the status in Ticker requests.

payload.rawSql:
WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT upper(trim('${payload.symbol}')) AS symbol
)
INSERT INTO ticker_requests (symbol)
SELECT c.symbol
FROM candidate c
WHERE c.symbol ~ '^[A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9.=-]{0,31}$'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM instruments i WHERE i.symbol = c.symbol)
ON CONFLICT (symbol) DO UPDATE SET status = 'pending', note = NULL, processed_at = NULL

elements.title: Symbol
elements.tooltip: Stock or crypto, e.g. NVDA, CSU.TO, RMS.PA, XMR

panels.title: Ticker requests
panels.description: Recent add-ticker requests and their status (pending → done / not_found / error). Rows persist so re-adding is idempotent; the note explains each outcome.

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.symbol AS "Ticker", r.status AS "Status", coalesce(r.note, '') AS "Note", r.requested_at AS "Requested", r.processed_at AS "Processed" FROM ticker_requests r ORDER BY r.requested_at DESC LIMIT 15

panels.title: Current watchlist
panels.description: Instruments on the weekly-email watchlist. When this is empty the email falls back to REPORT_SYMBOLS, then to every tracked instrument.

targets.rawSql: SELECT i.symbol AS "Symbol", i.name AS "Name", i.kind AS "Kind", i.currency AS "Currency" FROM instruments i WHERE i.in_watchlist ORDER BY i.symbol

panels.title: Add to watchlist
panels.description: Pick tracked instruments to add to the weekly-email watchlist.

payload.rawSql: UPDATE instruments SET in_watchlist = true WHERE upper(symbol) = ANY(string_to_array(replace(upper('${payload.symbols}'), ' ', ''), ','))

elements.title: Symbols
elements.tooltip: Comma-separated tickers, e.g. AAPL,BN — case- and space-insensitive

panels.title: Remove from watchlist
panels.description: Pick instruments to drop from the weekly-email watchlist.

payload.rawSql: UPDATE instruments SET in_watchlist = false WHERE upper(symbol) = ANY(string_to_array(replace(upper('${payload.symbols}'), ' ', ''), ','))

elements.title: Symbols
elements.tooltip: Comma-separated tickers, e.g. AAPL,BN — case- and space-insensitive

panels.title: Add account
panels.description: Register a broker account, exchange, or wallet to book trades against. Submitting an existing name updates its details instead of duplicating it.

payload.rawSql:
INSERT INTO accounts (name, broker, currency, note)
SELECT c.name, NULLIF(c.broker, ''), c.currency, NULLIF(c.note, '')
FROM (SELECT trim('${payload.name}') AS name,
             trim('${payload.broker}') AS broker,
             COALESCE(NULLIF(upper(trim('${payload.currency}')), ''), 'EUR') AS currency,
             trim('${payload.note}') AS note) c
WHERE c.name <> '' AND c.currency ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$'
ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE
SET broker = EXCLUDED.broker, currency = EXCLUDED.currency, note = EXCLUDED.note

panels.title: Record transaction
panels.description: Append one buy or sell to the portfolio ledger. The account must exist and the symbol must already be tracked (add it above first). Quantity and price are positive numbers in the trade currency, which defaults to the instrument's listing currency; the date defaults to today. Holdings, cost basis, and P/L on the Portfolio dashboard are derived from these rows.

payload.rawSql:
INSERT INTO portfolio_transactions
    (account_id, instrument_id, trade_date, side, quantity, price, fees, currency, note)
SELECT a.id, i.id, COALESCE(f.trade_date, CURRENT_DATE),
       f.side, f.quantity, f.price, COALESCE(f.fees, 0),
       COALESCE(f.currency, i.currency),
       NULLIF(trim('${payload.note}'), '')
FROM (SELECT lower(trim('${payload.side}')) AS side,
             substring(trim('${payload.quantity}') from '^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?$')::numeric AS quantity,
             substring(trim('${payload.price}') from '^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?$')::numeric AS price,
             substring(trim('${payload.fees}') from '^[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)?$')::numeric AS fees,
             substring(upper(trim('${payload.currency}')) from '^[A-Z]{3}$') AS currency,
             to_date(substring(trim('${payload.trade_date}') from '^[0-9]{4}-(?:0[1-9]|1[0-2])-(?:0[1-9]|[12][0-9]|3[01])$'),
                     'YYYY-MM-DD') AS trade_date) f
JOIN accounts a ON a.name = trim('${payload.account}')
JOIN instruments i ON i.symbol = upper(trim('${payload.symbol}'))
WHERE f.side IN ('buy', 'sell')
  AND f.quantity > 0 AND f.price IS NOT NULL
  -- Blank is fine (it means "default"); typed-but-unparseable is not, so the
  -- row is dropped rather than quietly booked with today's date or no fees.
  AND (trim('${payload.fees}') = '' OR f.fees IS NOT NULL)
  AND (trim('${payload.currency}') = '' OR f.currency IS NOT NULL)
  AND (trim('${payload.trade_date}') = '' OR f.trade_date IS NOT NULL)

elements.title: Currency
elements.tooltip: Optional — defaults to the instrument's listing currency

panels.title: Accounts
panels.description: Accounts trades can be booked against, and how many the ledger holds for each.

targets.rawSql: SELECT a.name AS "Account", a.currency AS "Ccy", COALESCE(a.broker, '') AS "Broker", (SELECT count(*) FROM portfolio_transactions t WHERE t.account_id = a.id) AS "Trades" FROM accounts a ORDER BY a.name

panels.title: Recent transactions
panels.description: The last 15 ledger entries, in the currency each trade settled in. Nothing appeared? The form silently inserts no row when the account or symbol is unknown or a number doesn't parse.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t.trade_date AS "Date", a.name AS "Account", i.symbol AS "Symbol", t.side AS "Side", t.quantity AS "Quantity", t.price AS "Price", t.fees AS "Fees", t.currency AS "Ccy", COALESCE(t.note, '') AS "Note" FROM portfolio_transactions t JOIN accounts a ON a.id = t.account_id JOIN instruments i ON i.id = t.instrument_id ORDER BY t.trade_date DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT 15
